components.purpose: Page title and one-line intro with no image or buttons. Its guidance says it is a plain heading with optional subheading and description, and it allows placement at the top.
The plans as side-by-side cards, each with name, monthly price, highlights, and a CTA button. Its guidance says to use it for presenting plans with a button per plan.
The full comparison grid, with every feature as a row and a column per plan, placed under the plan cards. Its guidance names it as the feature-by-plan grid for a pricing page.
Billing FAQs at the bottom of the page. This model has no agent guidance, so I chose it by name for question-and-answer content; confirm its fields before use.
